title: Jonah Never Met a 'Whale'
author: QUILL
notes: Hebrew dag gadol = great fish. Nebi Yunus 2014 destruction is real. Tarshish two dashed candidates. Not-proven line in beat 8.

beats.text: The Book of Jonah never says 'whale.'
beats.say: The Book of JOE-nah never says 'whale.'

beats.text: It says dag gadol: a great fish. The strangest part lies under his tomb.
beats.say: It says DAHG gah-DOLE: a great fish. The strangest part lies under his tomb.

beats.text: It swallows him for three days and three nights.
beats.label: GREAT FISH

beats.text: God says go east to Nineveh. But Jonah runs the other way.
beats.say: God says go east to NIN-eh-vuh. But JOE-nah runs the other way.

beats.text: He boards a ship at Joppa for Tarshish: maybe Spain, maybe Turkey.
beats.say: He boards a ship at JOP-ah for TAR-shish: maybe Spain, maybe Turkey.

beats.text: Freed, he warns Nineveh: forty days, and it falls.
beats.say: Freed, he warns NIN-eh-vuh: forty days, and it falls.

beats.text: Nineveh, a city three days' journey across, repents, even its king.
beats.say: NIN-eh-vuh, a city three days' journey across, repents, even its king.

beats.text: Not proven: no Assyrian record mentions Jonah's mission.
beats.say: Not proven: no Assyrian record mentions JOE-nah's mission.

beats.text: In 2014, ISIS blew up his traditional tomb in Mosul.
beats.say: In 2014, EYE-sis blew up his traditional tomb in Mosul.
beats.label: DESTROYED 2014

beats.text: Under the rubble, Assyrian remains were later found, beneath ancient Nineveh.
beats.say: Under the rubble, Assyrian remains were later found, beneath ancient NIN-eh-vuh.

beats.text: The Book of Jonah never says 'whale.' Would you run, or go?
beats.say: The Book of JOE-nah never says 'whale.' Would you run, or go?

youtube.description:
The Book of Jonah says dag gadol, a great fish. And the strangest part of his story lies under his tomb.
No Assyrian record mentions his mission. The 2014 destruction of the Nebi Yunus shrine is real.
#Jonah #BibleHistory #Archaeology #MythUnearthed
